source_archive.name: BU1LD_Research_Atlas_Flagships_v4_REPRO_CORRECTED_2026-08-12.zip
source_archive.note: Recovered Library archive; no canonical remote source SHA is asserted by this evidence record.

preexisting_archive_integrity_defect.policy: Do not rewrite the package manifest or historical files merely to make the archive hash gate green.

protocol.task: autocorrelated 5D synthetic sequence prediction with delayed rare-event contribution
protocol.estimator: same Ridge estimator with validation-selected alpha across methods

apen.fresh_artifact_identity: All numerical CSV/JSON/PNG evidence retained by the experiment matched the packaged evidence; regenerated PDFs changed hash.
apen.falsification_outcome: Localized rare-event improvement survives while salience is informative, but the advantage collapses around 80% salience dropout and reverses at 100%; APEN is not a general-memory superiority result.

methods.proposed: Eigen-JEPA spectral representation with ridge prediction

eigen_jepa.fresh_artifact_identity: Scientific CSV/JSON/NPZ evidence matched packaged hashes; regenerated real_market_top_eigenvalue.pdf changed hash.
eigen_jepa.falsification_outcome: Eigen-JEPA improves matrix MSE versus persistence in point estimate but does not establish superiority over direct raw/log ridge forecasting; persistence is best on the reported subspace-distance metric. No metric shopping is permitted.

npms.protocol: four controlled reservoir memory regimes with seven base reservoirs per regime, each original plus three random orthogonal transforms; 24 delay probes and leave-one-reservoir-out regime classification
npms.fresh_artifact_identity: Scientific artifacts matched packaged hashes; regenerated npms_memory_regimes.pdf changed hash.
npms.limitations: Controlled reservoirs only; coordinate invariance and regime discriminability do not by themselves establish causal use or transfer to trained modern sequence models.

memory_spectrum_transfer.protocol: 24 trained models: vanilla RNN and GRU, 14 hidden units, four seeds, delays 3/8/15; fresh-sequence delay-reconstruction spectra; random orthogonal rotation; leave-one-seed-out logistic delay-regime classification
memory_spectrum_transfer.artifact_identity: memory_spectra.csv, model_results.csv, summary.csv, completion.json and PNG were byte-identical before/after fresh rerun; only the regenerated PDF hash changed.
memory_spectrum_transfer.claim_boundary: Task-aligned functional spectra outperform six coarse parameter summaries for delay-regime identification in this controlled trained RNN/GRU study; nonlinear reparameterization, optimizer transfer, LLMs and natural sequence tasks remain untested.

pen.evidence_source: MODEL-PEN handoff, workspace hash ledger, claim-evidence matrix and retained result/report artifacts in Library
pen.negative_result: PEN slightly beats no-memory but loses to attention-only and does not beat random writes; learned salience superiority is unsupported.
pen.blocker: A single executable MODEL-PEN archive/source tree has not been recovered into this runtime, so retained historical metrics are not promoted to a fresh reproduction. APEN evidence is not inherited by PEN.
